title: Back to brackets goes back one real step
request: When the reader opened a bracket from the playoffs list, the Back to brackets button should go back one real step in the browser history, so the browser Back button has no dead press afterward. A direct link, a deep link, a delete and the error banner keep working. Update the history docs and rows PLAYOFF-43, 44 and 45.

criteria.text: Sequences A, C, D need exactly 1 browser Back press to leave /playoffs with 0 dead presses (real browser, fake data, 390x844 touch); B and E keep their numbers (1; 3 with 0 dead)
Reload on an open bracket, then Back to brackets: goes back one step and shows the list; a push made from a ?bracket= entry carries no mark (unit test) and still replaces

After Back to brackets the list is at its top (PLAYOFF-41 stays true), measured in a short window where the list scrolls; delete of the open bracket still replaces (unit test); the error banner button works (real browser C)
Unit tests: changed assertions are edited to the exact new calls, none skipped or loosened; typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit, integrity pass at the head commit
Docs and rows PLAYOFF-41 to 45, PLAYADMIN-38, the-playoffs-page.md (paragraph, interrupt table, footer) say what the code does; links 0 broken; totals stay 1,958 and 116

reviews.summary: Independent plan review: design is sound and the smallest option (mark in history.state, verified in react-router source: a replace with no state wipes the mark, reload keeps it). Blocking: (1) a push made while the list shows over an entry that already has ?bracket= (admin loading, error banner, legacy null bracket) would carry the mark and Back to brackets would land on that bracket entry; fix = mark only when the address has no bracket param. (2) typecheck break: untyped makeAdminData in bracket-view.test.tsx needs closeBracket. (3) two existing assertions (actions.test:149, season-from-bracket.test:154) change on purpose. (4) scroll after a POP is only knowable in a browser; fix after the POP if not 0. Docs list was short: PLAYOFF-41/42, PLAYADMIN-38 added.
